pixel_policy: Selected generated PNG files copied byte-for-byte. Rectangle metadata selects central panoramic artwork, removing black padding at runtime. Original collision mask remains authoritative; generated silhouettes are not exact.

assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production 2D platform-game terrain panorama. Edit the supplied 960x160 reference into a high-definition softly hand-painted fantasy illustration. Output a very wide 6:1 panorama, ideally 3840x640. Preserve the EXACT composition, silhouettes, placement and scale of the two ornate dragon heads, intertwined long rocky scaled bodies, blue glowing eyes and small blue stars. Preserve every black gap and the positions of all terrain edges; no new platforms, actors, doors, text or UI. Keep the same rust/copper/brown stone and deep blue palette, with smooth brushwork, fine scale detail, bevelled edges, subtle warm highlights. Black void background. This image is a terrain color layer that will be clipped to the original collision mask, so positional fidelity to the reference is essential. No border, no lettering, no watermark. One complete panorama, no panels.

reference.encoding: Rust inspect_vgaspec indexed pixels, palette VGA components times4, black transparent cells;960x160; no retouching
